explanation: The negation of the Alon–Saks–Seymour conjecture χ(G) ≤ bp(G) + 1, quantified over all finite simple graphs. It is disproved by Huang–Sudakov (2012). The biclique-partition definition is correct: the sides are disjoint, every edge is in some biclique, every biclique pair is an edge, and each edge lies in a unique biclique. The statement is faithful and correctly tagged solved.
